remaining_open_items: Manufacturer drawing numbers the four pads but does not supply USB signal names; complete signal-to-library-coordinate binding remains unverified.
Current derating and contact heating model are unavailable.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Missing validated pin-function/physical-terminal binding; USB protocol is not simulable. Resolution: The archived Lumberg 2411 02 sheet p2 numbers the four PCB terminals 1-4 in both the front view and the '*a printed circuit board layout', and gives contact resistance <=30 mOhm, rated current <=1 A and rated voltage 30 V AC at 20 C. A function-agnostic per-contact model (pad k to mating contact k through the sourced Rc max) needs only this numbering, not USB signal names, so the pin-function blocker is sidestepped rather than closed: signal names stay unassigned and the shell/housing tabs stay unmodeled. USB protocol stays out of scope.
